#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    bool possible = true;
    while (m > 0 && possible) {
        int rem = m % w;
        if (rem == 0 || rem == 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else {
            if (rem == w - 1) {
                m++;
            } else {
                possible = false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << (possible ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
